newsitem.title: UK: British Biotech slumps in wake of cancer drug news.
newsitem.headline: British Biotech slumps in wake of cancer drug news.

text.p: Shares in British Biotech Plc continued in the doldrums on Tuesday following the company's cautious update on its anti-cancer drug Marimastat, published on Monday.

Shares in British Biotech were among the most actively traded in London on Tuesday but also one of the worst performing. The shares fell 13p, or 6.3 percent to 194-1/2p by 1020 GMT after shedding 21-1/2p yesterday.

Analysts who were hoping for some signs that the new drug would eventually reach the market were disappointed as the company made it clear there was still a long way to go before the drug's potential as a blockbuster could be confirmed.
But one specialist salesman at a leading brokerage said those who were left disappointed had too high expectations.
"We have regarded the shares as significantly overvalued for some time," the salesman said. "In our view the right price would be around 30-40 percent below current levels."

Exactly a year ago, the shares could be picked up for around 80p each. Much of the sharp advance in the share price was pinned on hopes that one day the Marimastat drug could have sales of $4 billion a year and turn British Biotech into one of Britain's biggest companies.
